checked_classes: Spec violations — checked the added/modified OpenSpec delta specs, generated harness locations from file_tree, AGENTS.md generation path, drift-check wiring through lint:agents, and documented Kimi/MiniMax limitations; the packet includes matching evidence or implementation for each acceptance requirement.

Correctness — checked install-exports path handling, byte comparisons, stale-role removal planning, Codex config merge behavior, AGENTS.md generation, roster/structure linting, and CLI exit behavior; no concrete logic defect is evident from the diff.

Regressions — checked broadened Claude agent linting, committed dist/src parity, workflow path filters, and preservation of native Codex config outside generated markers; no regression is supported by the packet.

Security — checked symlink refusal for export/install paths, MiniMax runtime-data ignore and committable-file lint, third-party checkout credential handling, and Docker context exclusions; no blocking exposure is evident in the diff.

Constraint breaches — checked project blocking constraints for applicability; no Go, schema, store, handler, Helm, or credential-bearing source/config changes in the diff trigger a concrete constraint violation.

Silent failure — checked --skip-drift behavior, git ls-files failure handling, damaged Codex marker handling, missing creator handling, and drift script aggregation; failures are surfaced non-zero rather than silently passing.
